metadata.question: Does Lake Urmia show a lower water redness in July 18 compared to April 23, 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Lake Urmia, Iran (approximate coordinates: 37.5°N, 45.5°E) - Dates: April 23, 2016 and July 18, 2016 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (best for water color analysis with Red/Green bands), or Landsat 8 OLI as fallback 2. Masking strategy: - The question is about water redness, not clouds - Should mask clouds to get valid water pixels - May need to mask land areas to focus on water body 3. Logic: - Water redness typically measured using Red band reflectance or Red/Green ratio - Lower redness in July 18 vs April 23 means: July_redness < April_redness → Answer A - Higher or equal redness → Answer B - Handle cases: C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels after masking), C3 (invalid calculation) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Lake Urmia geometry const lakeUrmia = ee.Geometry.Point([45.5, 37.5]).buffer(20000); // 2. Define dates const date1 = '2016-04-23'; const date2 = '2016-07-18'; // 3. Function to mask clouds for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 4. Try to get Sentinel-2 images let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeUrmia) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeUrmia) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 23 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`July 18 images: ${size2}`); // 5. Fallback to Landsat 8 if needed if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 8 fallback...'); function maskL8clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeUrmia) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(7, 'day')) .map(maskL8clouds); col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeUrmia) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(7, 'day')) .map(maskL8clouds); const ls1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const ls2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat Apr images: ${ls1}, Jul images: ${ls2}`); if (ls1 === 0 || ls2 === 0) { console.log('No images found for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 6. Get median composites const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); // 7. Calculate redness (Red band reflectance) const redBand = size1 > 0 ? 'B4' : 'SR_B4'; // 8. Calculate mean red reflectance with pixel count const stats1 = img1.select(redBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: lakeUrmia, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = img2.select(redBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: lakeUrmia, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const red1 = stats1.mean || stats1[redBand + '_mean']; const red2 = stats2.mean || stats2[redBand + '_mean']; const count1 = stats1.count || stats1[redBand + '_count']; const count2 = stats2.count || stats2[redBand + '_count']; console.log(`April 23 Red: ${red1}, Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`July 18 Red: ${red2}, Pixels: ${count2}`); // 9. Validation if (!count1 || !count2 || count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (red1 === null || red2 === null || isNaN(red1) || isNaN(red2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 10. Compare redness if (red2 < red1) { console.log('July shows lower redness than April.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('July does not show lower redness than April.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
